body.x: GOYANG, Korea (AVING Special Report on 'KES 2006') -- <Visual News> BFO presented ''NEMO'' a tiny USB-capable mobile speaker for PC and MP3P during KES 2006. Since it is compact and square, you can pile them up as if playing with lego blocks.

< AVING Special Report Team for ''KES 2006'': Publisher & Editor, Min Choi, Kevin Choi, Caleb Ma, Jason Lee, Gaius Park, Phoebe Kwon, Sheri Choi, Joshua Shim, Daniel Sirh, Rose Kim, Paul Kim, Samuel Kim, Abe Shim, Grace Won >
